title: npm run repin cannot pin a sibling's local build
foundBy: user report (host): "it doesn't seem possible anymore to have make repin do pin on local builds, which haven't been published to ghcr.io or npmjs.com or built in the Github CI builds"
details: `npm run repin` moves each `@codesweep-ai` pin to its project's last CI build, and to nothing else. A build that a clean gate recorded in the build store is invisible to it, and `scripts/with-npmrevs.sh` serves none of the store's packages. So a change across ui and a sibling cannot pin its own parts before they are pushed.
